routes.name: Visa-exempt entry
routes.summary: Citizens of listed exempt countries can enter without a visitor visa. The official list is grouped by region. Stay length isn't given on that page, and the list has some countries in both columns.

routes.name: Visitor Visa
routes.summary: For people who aren't visa-exempt and want to visit up to 30 days. No paid work allowed.

savings.note: or support from family or friends in Vanuatu

other: Return ticket within 30 days of arrival

routes.name: Transit Visa
routes.summary: Transit visa for up to 24 hours within the airport proclaimed area, per the comparison table on the official Visit page.

routes.name: Employment Visa
routes.summary: Skilled work for a sponsoring employer for more than two months. Valid 12 months, multiple entry. Can only change status to Investor Visa.

routes.name: Short-Term Employment Visa
routes.summary: Employer-sponsored skilled work, for listed occupations or special skills approved by the Commissioner of Labour. The page says 1-4 months validity but also a 6 month work cap, so check with the department.

routes.name: Specialist Skill Visa
routes.summary: Specialist work up to two weeks, single entry. Needs employer sponsorship and a letter from a Vanuatu-registered company.

routes.name: Development Support Visa
routes.summary: For people working with a government agency, development program, UN agency or aid entity. Up to 5 years, extensions allowed. Needs nomination by the relevant party.

routes.name: Religious Worker Visa
routes.summary: For religious activity in Vanuatu with a sponsoring religious organization. Up to 5 years. A security bond may be required for stays over 90 days.

routes.name: Residence Visa: Partner or Child
routes.summary: For spouses or de facto partners of Vanuatu citizens (including after the partner's death) and dependent children of citizens. Usually 1, 3, 5 or 10 years.

routes.name: Residence Visa: Employee
routes.summary: For people employed by a Vanuatu-based business for at least 12 months. Usually 1, 3, 5 or 10 years. Spouse and children can be included.

routes.name: Residence Visa: Self-funded Resident
routes.summary: For people with certified income, no work needed. Usually 1, 3, 5 or 10 years. Family can't be added to this category, but a partner's income counts toward the higher figure.

income.note: 500,000 VUV per month with a spouse or de facto partner

routes.name: Residence Visa: Foreign Investor
routes.summary: For holders of a VIPA foreign investor approval certificate and a business license where needed. Duration varies.

routes.name: Residence Visa: Leasehold Holder
routes.summary: For owners of Vanuatu leasehold property worth at least 10 million VUV.

routes.name: Permanent Residency Visa
routes.summary: Part A (subclass 131) is for ni-Vanuatu nationals, people of ni-Vanuatu descent, or people who lived in Vanuatu at least 12 months. Part B (132-135) is for serious investors. No fees or amounts on the page.

routes.name: Citizenship by Naturalization
routes.summary: Needs 10 years of continuous, ordinary and legal residence in Vanuatu. Language rules and fees aren't stated on the immigration page, so check with the Vanuatu Citizenship Office. Dual citizenship rules weren't confirmed.
